abort.different_host: The SSH host key belongs to a different host than the one configured.

error.host_key_changed: The host presented a different SSH host key than the one that was confirmed.
error.invalid_private_key: The private key could not be read. Paste an unencrypted OpenSSH or PEM private key.
error.missing_credentials: Enter a password, a private key, or both.
error.smartctl_not_found: smartctl was not found on the host. Install smartmontools.
error.sudo_failed: smartctl could not be run with sudo. Allow the user to run smartctl with sudo without a password.

confirm_host_key.description:
{host} presented an SSH host key with this fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the output of `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` on the host. Your credentials are only sent once you confirm.
confirm_host_key.title: Confirm the host key

reauth_confirm.description: Enter the credentials for {host}. Its SSH host key has the fingerprint `{fingerprint}`.
reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]

reauth_host_key_changed.description:
The SSH host key of {host} changed. Its new fingerprint is `{fingerprint}`.

Only continue if you reinstalled the host or regenerated its SSH keys. Otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection.
reauth_host_key_changed.title: The host key changed

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the server whose disks to monitor.
data_description.password: The SSH password. Leave empty when you use a private key.
data_description.port: The SSH port of the server.
data_description.private_key: An unencrypted SSH private key in OpenSSH or PEM format. Leave empty when you use a password.
data_description.use_sudo: Enable when the user is not root and may run smartctl with sudo without a password.
data_description.username: The user to log in as.

user.description: Monitor the SMART health of the disks of a Linux, Unraid, Proxmox VE, TrueNAS or other server over SSH. The server needs smartmontools 7 or newer.

host_key_changed.message: The SSH host key of the server changed.

host_key_missing.message: The SSH host key of the server has not been confirmed yet.

invalid_auth.message: The server rejected the SSH credentials.

self_test_failed.message: Could not control the self-test of {device}: {error}

error.invalid_device: Each line must be a device path, optionally followed by a smartctl device type, for example `/dev/bus/0 megaraid,3`.

data.skip_standby: Do not wake up sleeping disks

data_description.devices: Disks to read instead of discovering them, one per line. Use this for RAID controllers smartctl cannot scan, for example `/dev/sg0 cciss,0`.
data_description.skip_standby: Keep the last values of disks in standby instead of spinning them up.
